visualChecks: Large islands use deterministic multi-lobe terrain generation instead of small single ellipses
The visible coast is a continuous cross-hex land mass with shallow-water, sand and paper-white bands
Mountain artwork is a connected range spanning several hex cells and uses wide spacing between placements
The tactical harbor places its town on land and rotates its long pier toward the adjacent sea cell
Strategic zoom retains the compact team-colored anchor marker
The current Pixi sea chart can be exported through the in-game PNG capture dialog
limitations: The coast is visually smoothed across hexes while movement and combat still use discrete land cells
Changing deterministic terrain generation invalidates old map hashes and starts a fresh battle
